maranello-luxury-auto-garages-tx.summary: Maranello is the most ambitious garage condo project in North Texas: a 200,000 sq ft, inward-facing building on 11+ acres off the George Bush Turnpike in west Plano. Each of the 79 deeded garages opens through a glass door onto a 60,000 sq ft open-air concourse, so the whole building works like a private car show that never closes.
maranello-luxury-auto-garages-tx.address: Ohio Dr & Maple Shade Ln, Plano, TX
maranello-luxury-auto-garages-tx.size: 1,000 to 2,000 sq ft (most 25 ft wide, 40 to 80 ft deep)
maranello-luxury-auto-garages-tx.doors: Glass garage doors facing the interior concourse
maranello-luxury-auto-garages-tx.price: About $650 per sq ft, roughly $650K to $1.3M+; concourse-facing units add about $200K
amenities: 13,000 sq ft two-story members lounge
60,000 sq ft open-air concourse for shows and private events
Steel mezzanine and staircase in every unit
App-controlled HVAC and full utilities per unit
On-site service center, detailing and paint correction
Window tint, PPF and bodywork on site
Professional photo studio

t11-car-condos-at-cota-tx.summary: T11 sits at Turn 11 of Circuit of the Americas, the Formula 1 track southeast of Austin, and is built by the circuit itself. Owners get a private race viewing platform and dedicated track time, which no other Texas garage condo can match.
t11-car-condos-at-cota-tx.address: 9201 Circuit of the Americas Blvd, Austin, TX
t11-car-condos-at-cota-tx.units: Five unit types; roughly 175 planned across the project
t11-car-condos-at-cota-tx.size: 1,500 to 6,000 sq ft, each with a ground-floor garage and mezzanine
t11-car-condos-at-cota-tx.price: From about $465K; large finished units run $2M+
amenities: Private race viewing platform at Turn 11
Dedicated owner track time
Clubhouse with pool, outdoor lounge and grills
Club room and conference rooms
Showers and on-site management office
Four finish-out packages with Thermador or Gaggenau appliances

garages-of-the-americas-tx.summary: Garages of the Americas is an 18-acre campus directly across from Circuit of the Americas, developed by racer Tim Myers. It is the volume play near COTA: around 200 climate-controlled units, with about half already sold and several buyers taking multiple units.
garages-of-the-americas-tx.size: 25x50 and 30x50 ft units are common; mezzanines sit 14 ft above the floor
garages-of-the-americas-tx.ceilings: Tall enough for a 14 ft-high mezzanine with trailer parking and lifts underneath
amenities: Across the street from COTA
Climate-controlled units
Room for trailers and car lifts under the mezzanine
Detailers and trackside service providers
Professional racing coach on site

toy-cave-luxury-garages-tx.summary: Toy Cave puts 56 large garages just inside the Houston core, off W. 12th Street near the Galleria and Memorial. Every unit comes finished with its own HVAC, and the 3,400 sq ft clubhouse has an F1 racing simulator, bar and private rooms.
toy-cave-luxury-garages-tx.address: 4411 W 12th St, Houston, TX (per project map)
toy-cave-luxury-garages-tx.developer: Toy Cave Luxury Garage Condos (president Byron Plant)
toy-cave-luxury-garages-tx.size: About 1,500 sq ft (30 ft wide x 50 ft deep) plus a roughly 500 sq ft mezzanine
amenities: 3,400 sq ft clubhouse open 24/7
F1 racing simulator, billiards, bar and kitchen
Private rooms plus outdoor patio and grill
Car detailing center
Individual HVAC with Wi-Fi thermostat in each unit
EV-charger-ready electrical
Gated access with CCTV

garages-of-america-plano-tx.summary: Garages of America (formerly Garages of Texas) is the most proven garage condo builder in the state. It has opened 13 communities across Texas and sold about 850 garages since its Plano flagship broke ground in 2014. That first site sold all 69 units before construction finished.
garages-of-america-plano-tx.developer: Garages of America (founders Fred Gans and Jack Griffin)
garages-of-america-plano-tx.units: 69 at the Plano flagship; about 850 sold across 13 Texas communities
garages-of-america-plano-tx.price: Resales across the brand commonly list from the mid $300Ks to $1.3M+
amenities: 13 locations across DFW, Houston and Austin
Owner HOAs that host events
Monthly first-Saturday car showcase at the Carrollton site
Units built out as lounges, gyms and wet bars by owners

dominion-motor-club-tx.summary: Dominion Motor Club in far north San Antonio pairs tall, climate-controlled garages with a clubhouse that has indoor and outdoor gathering space. Resales here are known for high-end finish-outs, with bars, full baths and finished mezzanines. A second location with about 50 units is under construction.
dominion-motor-club-tx.units: Original campus plus Dominion Motor Club 2.0 (about 50 units)
dominion-motor-club-tx.size: Example resale: 1,325 sq ft. 2.0 units run 1,031 to 1,700 sq ft
dominion-motor-club-tx.price: Example 2023-built resale listed at $395K; $5K reserves a 2.0 unit
amenities: Gated, climate-controlled, 24-hour access
Clubhouse with indoor and outdoor gathering spaces
Owners commonly add full baths, bars and finished mezzanines

trailblazer-garages-las-colinas-tx.summary: Trailblazer's Las Colinas community sits on N. Star Drive in Irving, minutes from DFW Airport and Love Field. Units are sold as blank-canvas shells with a 450 sq ft mezzanine, so you build exactly what you want, and the gated site shares a clubhouse with showers and a car wash.
trailblazer-garages-las-colinas-tx.size: 1,825 sq ft (including a 450 sq ft mezzanine) and 2,160 sq ft; units can be combined
trailblazer-garages-las-colinas-tx.price: Launched at about $275/sq ft: $501,875 (1,825 sq ft) and $594,000 (2,160 sq ft)
amenities: Gated with video surveillance
Clubhouse with meeting area, restrooms and showers
Community car wash station and RV dump station
Insulated, climate-controlled units
Wi-Fi throughout

g2-motorsports-park-garage-condos-tx.summary: G2 Motorsports Park is a private road course on 180 acres in Anna, north of McKinney. Its garage condos come with a mezzanine and an outdoor balcony that looks over the track, plus access to a 20,000 sq ft members clubhouse.
g2-motorsports-park-garage-condos-tx.size: 1,200 to 2,200 sq ft base level, plus mezzanine and track-view balcony
g2-motorsports-park-garage-condos-tx.price: Example listing: 1,260 sq ft at $495K (about $393/sq ft)
amenities: Trackside location on a private road course
Initial track design by Tilke, final by Bob Barnard
20,000 sq ft two-story clubhouse and event center
Access to paddock garages during track events

shavano-garage-condos-tx.summary: Shavano Garage Condominiums is a 39-unit community off Lockhill-Selma Road in north San Antonio, built for cars, bikes and boats. It is one of the lowest entry prices in Texas for a garage condo with a real clubhouse.
amenities: Clubhouse with kitchen, bar and restrooms
Indoor and outdoor entertainment areas
Climate control and plumbing in units
Optional mezzanines and lifts

big-tex-garage-condos-tx.summary: Big Tex Garage Condos in Tomball, northwest of Houston, is one of the most affordable ways to own a garage condo in a major Texas metro, with Phase 2 units priced under $190K.

garage-werks-tx.summary: Garage Werks in Cypress is a budget-friendly Houston-area option, with units starting under $200K.

the-motor-enclave-fl.summary: The Motor Enclave is Florida's original car country club: about 200 acres next to Tampa Executive Airport with a 1.5-mile performance track and roughly 300 privately owned garages. It was built by Brad Oleshansky, who also built M1 Concourse in Michigan, and its event business is now one of the biggest in the category.
the-motor-enclave-fl.size: Small car suites up to units large enough for RVs and trailers; many include bath and kitchenette
the-motor-enclave-fl.price: Launched from about $180K; resales now start in the high $300Ks
amenities: 1.5-mile private performance track
About 200 acres near I-4 and I-75
42,000 sq ft of event space
Large units fit RVs and trailers
Sister communities planned in Sarasota and Orlando

circuit-florida-car-condos-fl.summary: Circuit Florida in Auburndale, between Tampa and Orlando, is a true live-at-the-track community. Its 75 townhome-style garage condos are zoned for full-time living and line a 1.7-mile, 14-turn road course with more than 40 feet of elevation change, which is rare in Florida.
circuit-florida-car-condos-fl.size: 838 sq ft (Monza loft) up to 2,688 sq ft (Le Mans, 2 bed / 2 bath)
circuit-florida-car-condos-fl.price: About $475K to $1.8M, fully furnished; club initiation about $80K plus about $800/month dues
amenities: 1.7-mile, 14-turn private road course
About 160 member track days a year
Zoned for full-time residence
Two clubhouses including a spa and restaurant
Sim rigs, coaching and on-site mechanics
Lifts can double capacity up to 12 cars per unit

p1-motor-club-fl.summary: P1 Motor Club is the biggest motorsports country club being built in Florida: 650 acres in St. Lucie County with a 3-mile track, a planned 4.5-mile circuit and almost 10 miles of driving surface at full build-out. Garage townhomes put car space downstairs and living space upstairs, overlooking the track.
p1-motor-club-fl.address: Okeechobee Rd, Port St. Lucie area, FL
p1-motor-club-fl.units: About 200 residences planned (68 sold so far)
p1-motor-club-fl.price: Real estate about $1.4M (members only); membership from about $192K plus annual dues
p1-motor-club-fl.timeline: First track opening late 2026; real estate construction around early 2027
amenities: 3-mile track, with a 4.5-mile circuit planned
Karting, rally, drift and off-road areas
Clubhouse with rooftop bar, pool and courts
Mercedes-AMG partner fleet for members
About 280 members

sebring-motor-garages-fl.summary: Sebring Motor Garages is the official motor condominium partner of Sebring International Raceway, home of the 12 Hours of Sebring. The gated, 15-acre community is less than a mile from the track, and owners can get up to 25 track days a year through the Sebring Driving Club.
sebring-motor-garages-fl.size: 25, 30 or 60 ft wide, all 55 ft deep
sebring-motor-garages-fl.ceilings: Mezzanine clearance of 10 or 14 ft (fits motorhomes and lifts)
sebring-motor-garages-fl.price: Phase 1 condos from the $300Ks built out; townhomes just over $1M
amenities: Under a mile from Sebring International Raceway
Up to 25 track days a year via Sebring Driving Club
3,000 sq ft clubhouse with heated pool, bar and sim room
Daily concierge, parcel room and rental desk
Units zoned for overnight stays, with bath and three-phase power

collectionsuites-miami-fl.summary: CollectionSuites in Doral is Miami's ultra-luxury option: 38 private suites of 2,000+ sq ft with staffed security around the clock. It is built as much for watches, art and wine as for cars, and each suite has its own fire suppression and remote camera access.
collectionsuites-miami-fl.developer: Lino Fayen and Juan Manuel Fayen
collectionsuites-miami-fl.size: 2,000+ sq ft, with optional bath, closet, wet bar and loft
collectionsuites-miami-fl.price: Launched from about $700K; current suites from about $1.1M
amenities: 24/7 staffed security and management
Gated compound with app-based owner access
In-suite cameras viewable remotely
Per-suite fire suppression and CO2 alerts
Custom finishes such as Italian ceramic or wood floors

naples-auto-vault-fl.summary: Naples Auto Vault is the Lutgert Companies' entry into collector condos, a name Naples buyers already know from luxury homebuilding. The deeded units are built inland and away from storm surge, with oversized doors and layered security, and the finishes are previewed at Clive Daniel Home.
naples-auto-vault-fl.doors: Oversized doors for specialty and tall vehicles
naples-auto-vault-fl.timeline: Phase I vertical construction underway; completion planned Q4 2026
amenities: Inland location away from coastal surge
Climate-controlled private units
Layered security
Built out as galleries, lounges or tasting rooms

auto-clubhouse-palm-beach-fl.summary: Auto ClubHouse Palm Beach in Jupiter is a 19-unit garage condo community in the Palm Beach Park of Commerce. Units have 22 ft clear ceilings and are built to South Florida hurricane standards. The brand plans 15+ locations nationally, and only a few of the original Jupiter units remain.
auto-clubhouse-palm-beach-fl.size: About 1,375 to 1,400 sq ft (55 x 25 ft)
amenities: Hurricane-rated doors and windows (Dade County standards)
CBS block demising walls and steel roof deck
Roof-mounted HVAC included
Bath stub-ups with shower and domestic water
150 amp panel and floor drain for motorhomes
Gated, climate-controlled community

indian-river-motorhaus-3-0-fl.summary: Indian River MotorHaus 3.0 is the fourth phase from the Vero Beach team that already sold out Vero Autohaus, MotorHaus and the 92-unit MotorHaus 2.0. It uses 7-inch tilt-wall concrete designed to double as a hurricane shelter, at prices well below most Florida luxury garages.
indian-river-motorhaus-3-0-fl.address: 7420 Old Dixie Hwy, Vero Beach, FL
indian-river-motorhaus-3-0-fl.size: 920 to 1,530 sq ft standard, with a 60 x 72 ft (4,000+ sq ft) option
indian-river-motorhaus-3-0-fl.doors: 12 x 14 or 14 x 14 ft storm-resistant automatic doors
amenities: 7-inch tilt-wall concrete built to hurricane-shelter standards
Optional backup generators, lifts and mezzanines
Pre-plumbed for bath with shower, pre-ducted for A/C
Gated campus with pond, wetlands and preserved oaks and palms
RV-capable electrical

paddock1-premium-garage-condos-fl.summary: Paddock1 is an urban Tampa garage condo at Adamo Drive and 34th Street, minutes from downtown and Ybor City. Every unit has a finished bathroom and is engineered for a loft and lifts. It was 80% presold before vertical construction started.
paddock1-premium-garage-condos-fl.price: Launched from about $255K; recent listings $435K to $600K
amenities: Finished bathroom in every unit
Pre-engineered for second-floor loft
Car lift ready
Climate controlled

motocave-luxury-car-condos-fl.summary: Motocave puts 43 car condos and a pool clubhouse in a 55,000 sq ft gated building on Gandy Boulevard in St. Petersburg. It sold more than half its units during construction and was nearly sold out by mid-2026.
motocave-luxury-car-condos-fl.price: About $350K+ ($275 to $375 per sq ft); recent listings to about $520K
amenities: Clubhouse with pool, TVs and games
Bathroom in every unit
Options for kitchen, wet bar, shower and mezzanine
Fully fenced with automatic gate

collection-674-fl.summary: Collection 674 in Oviedo is Central Florida's first purpose-built luxury car condo community: 34 gated, deeded units on Aloma Avenue east of SR 417. The specs are strong for the price, with 21 ft clear ceilings, 14 ft doors and a clubhouse with racing simulators.
collection-674-fl.developer: Lindsay Winter Bellinkoff and Ira Bellinkoff
collection-674-fl.size: 709 sq ft (Reserve), 949 sq ft, 1,227 sq ft (Pinnacle) and a 1,658 sq ft pull-through
amenities: 1,300 sq ft clubhouse with racing simulators
Detail and wash bay
24/7 monitored perimeter security
200 amp panels, fire sprinklers and A/C
Plumbing stubbed for private restrooms

vehicle-fortress-fl.summary: Vehicle Fortress in south Fort Myers is built for big rigs as well as cars. Doors run 15 to 20 ft wide with a 65 ft clear approach, and units combine up to 8,000 sq ft. That makes it one of the best Florida options for motorhomes, boats and large collections at a reasonable price.
vehicle-fortress-fl.size: From 21 x 50 ft; combinable to 2,000 to 8,000 sq ft
vehicle-fortress-fl.doors: 15 to 20 ft wide, with a 65 ft clear driveway approach
amenities: Individual A/C and insulation
50 amp RV outlet and water in each unit
Shared laundry, showers and meeting area
127,000 sq ft Phase 2 building
